requirements.text: The system shall be designed to support at least a dozen projects within the first two years of operation.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder mentioned 'uma dezena em dois anos' and expects exponential growth, establishing a minimum scalability target.

requirements.text: The system should be released for mass adoption only after initial pilots in Barra and Mozambique have consolidated the platform and resolved bugs.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder emphasized the importance of releasing only after pilot consolidation to avoid user discouragement from bugs.

requirements.text: The system shall support the feature of trail/marking tracking as a secondary functionality.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder mentioned trail marking as a secondary, non-priority functionality.

requirements.text: The system should be available for initial deployment and pilot use within 4 to 6 months from project start.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder stated that implementation in the Barra city website within 4 to 6 months would be excellent, setting a time-to-market constraint.

requirements.text: The system should have a more friendly interface for data capture, so that non-technical users (e.g., population, school users) can easily mark geographic features and fill forms.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder contrasted the platform's role as 'capturing in a more friendly way for the population' and mentioned that school users already use it to mark features, implying a need for ease of use.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to support integration with Vicons/Saga such that users can seamlessly access shared data layers, with the possibility of using the same credentials across platforms.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder expressed the desire that clicking from MaisLugar to Vicons/Saga should use the same password and login automatically.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want the platform to offer a direct export/import mechanism (e.g., plugin) to transfer data layers between MaisLugar and Vicom/Saga, so that users can leverage mature GIS tools without rebuilding functionality.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 repeatedly expresses a strong preference for integrating with existing tools like Saga rather than reinventing functionality (c65, c85, c99, c102, c103), and mentions plugin-style integration (c75, c76).

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to support different user roles with varying permissions (viewer, editor, manager), so that access to project data and actions can be controlled appropriately.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly described roles: general population (viewer), manager (can delete project), editor, and that permissions are per-project.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want the system to automatically capture metadata (timestamp, user who made the record) for each data entry, so that data provenance and audit trails are maintained.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned automatic capture of registration time and metadata about which user made the record.

requirements.text: As a platform administrator, I want the system to support a gamification system with user levels (e.g., Master, Pleno) and achievements across projects, so that user participation is motivated collectively.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder described gamification with medals, avatars, and user progression (Master, Pleno) based on contributions across projects.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want the system to allow setting visibility permissions for layers (e.g., public, technical users, scientists), so that I can control who can view each data layer within a project.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder repeatedly mentioned the need to define which layers are visible to the general public, technical users, or scientists, as a core feature of the platform.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to be able to share a project's web map or consolidated map image via a link that can be embedded in other websites, so that project results can be publicly displayed.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly described sharing map results as a web map link or image that can be copied and placed into another website.

requirements.text: As a manager, I want to be able to delete a project, so that I can remove obsolete or incorrect projects.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly stated the manager role can delete a project.

requirements.text: As a general user, I want to register with only an email, username, and password, so that I can quickly access the platform without a lengthy registration process.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder emphasized a fast registration process with minimal data (email, username, password) to encourage user onboarding.

requirements.text: As a developer, I want the platform's source code to be free and open, so that institutions can customize it as needed.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder clarifies that the code should be libre (free access to code), not just gratis.

requirements.text: The system shall allow the system administrator to install the platform on their own servers.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder expressed the desire for institutions to be able to install the program on their own servers for full control.

requirements.text: The system must ensure that confidential personal data (e.g., household locations) is accessible only to authorized roles such as managers.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly flagged household data as confidential and restricted to managers, implying a regulatory compliance need for data protection.

requirements.text: As a field data collector, I want to use a mobile application to capture georeferenced data (points, lines, polygons) and fill forms offline, so that I can work in areas without internet connectivity and later synchronize data automatically when connected.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned mobile access for field cadastros, specifically offline capture and automatic sync, referencing ODK as a model.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to create and edit vector data (points, lines, polygons) within a project, so that I can contribute georeferenced information to the platform.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder lists creation and editing of points, lines, and polygons as core functionalities.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to decide which data layers are exported, so that I can control the granularity and relevance of exported datasets.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 explicitly states 'É decidir as camadas, né que vão ser exportadas' (decide the layers that will be exported), indicating a requirement for layer selection during export.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to attach media files (photos, videos, audio) to collected data, so that I can enrich georeferenced records with multimedia evidence.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 asks about allowing media attachments, and Spk 1 confirms 'Sim dados de foto filmagem áudio' (yes, photo, video, audio data), making this an explicit requirement.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to control how data is visualized and shared per project, so that each institution can decide its own dissemination strategy.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 states 'cada instituição... decida a forma como vai fazer a divulgação dos dados' (each institution decides how to disseminate data), indicating a need for project-level sharing control.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to attach media files (photos, videos, audio) to my collected data, so that field observations are richly documented.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 asks 'O sistema deve permitir o anexo de arquivos de mídia entre os dados coletados pelos usuários' and Spk 1 confirms 'Sim dados de foto filmagem áudio'.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to export project data in CSV, XLS, and HTML formats, so that data can be shared with external systems and stakeholders.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 lists export formats: 'csv', 'xls html', and Spk 0 discusses export organization and filters, confirming this as a needed feature.
